settlement_source: Official final result per governing league, then ESPN/others in hierarchical order. Kalshi series sources: ESPN, Fox Sports, the Governing League (mlb.com). Terms https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/BASEBALLGAMEWIN.pdf.
settlement_variable: Team X strictly outscores opponent (more runs) over the full game incl. all extra innings, per first official final result (mlb.com/scores per non-binding instructions); corrections accepted only before Contract Expiration if clearly erroneous.
timezone: Eastern Time (ET) for time periods; API close_time UTC authoritative. Expiration time per terms 10:00 AM ET.
tie_handling: Tie after all extra innings (e.g. All-Star format): no Tie strike -> each team pays $1/n rounded down ($0.50); Tie strike -> YES and team strikes NO. Normal MLB games cannot tie.
rounding: n/a (strictly greater score); ties paid per tie clause
trading_close_vs_settlement: API close_time is set days after scheduled game start (sample: game Oct 28 -> close Oct 30 23:00Z), but the contract expires earlier once a winner is reported (Rule 7.2); trading is live in-play. Settlement timer 120s. Last Trading Time = Expiration time.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed, rescheduled and started within 48 h of original start: stays open, resolves on result; not started in 48 h / cancelled / abandoned: last fair price (sole discretion). Suspended and resumed within 48 h: resolves on completed game. Shortened/called game declared official by governing body with a winner: resolves on that result. Forfeit before first pitch: last fair price; after start: NO for forfeiting team. Venue change within 48 h same home/away OK; reversed: last fair price. Disqualification pre-game: last fair price; post-start: NO. Doubleheader/multi-postponement makeup mapping rules. Series-game number not reached: last fair price. Market Outcome Review (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion. can_close_early=1.
title_vs_rules_divergences: rules_secondary says market closes after rescheduled game 'within two days' while terms say expiry 10:00 AM ET, latest 3 days after original date
Shortened/rain-called games count as full-game result
Opponent pre-game forfeit does NOT pay YES

Rain-shortened games settle on official result
Doubleheader makeup-game mapping rules are complicated
Insider prohibitions (players, staff, owners) imply information asymmetry
Market Outcome Review (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion
